changeSet.author: niis

preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT count(*) FROM pg_tables WHERE schemaname = 'ds-issuer-service' AND tablename = 'keypair_resource'

changeSet.comment: Grants this Central Server's own database role read-only access to the Issuer Service's key-pair table, so the key-missing alert can read it without an Issuer Service call. Runs on every migration, including after a restore, since a restored dump carries no privileges. A no-op, without error, while that table does not exist yet.
changeSet.sql: grant usage on schema "ds-issuer-service" to "${db_user}"; grant select on "ds-issuer-service".keypair_resource to "${db_user}";
